en.textaboutme: Hello! My name is Oriol Badia. I am 21 years old and I live in Girona, my passion is the 3D world, video games and web development. Peaceful, eager for learn and have challenges. I like to work in teams and contribute ideas to projects. As a student, I am looking for a job for the summer months that gives me work experience, preferably in Calonge-Sant Antoni or Palamós.
